title: Website Development Roadmap
content_summary: Research requirements, homepage, product pages, testing on desktop and mobile, and launch.
source_note: Summary of accessible Notion test page, not a full-fidelity block export.
content:
Project: Small business website development.
Phase 1: Research website requirements and target users.
Phase 2: Create a homepage layout and navigation menu.
Phase 3: Develop product and contact pages.
Phase 4: Test the website on desktop and mobile devices.
Phase 5: Launch the website and collect feedback.
Primary goals:
- Simple navigation
- Fast page loading
- Mobile-friendly design
- Clear contact information
Next step: Draft the homepage design.
